authorInfo.bio: Oscar Wilde was an Irish writer celebrated for his wit, fairy tales and plays. The Picture of Dorian Gray is his only novel. His other works include The Importance of Being Earnest, The Happy Prince and The Ballad of Reading Gaol, spanning comedy, beauty and painful reflection.

sourceTitle: Miscellaneous Aphorisms; The Soul of Man
description: "Miscellaneous Aphorisms; The Soul of Man" by Oscar Wilde is a collection of philosophical reflections and essays written in the early 20th century. This work encapsulates Wilde's sharp wit and biting commentary on love, society, human nature, and morality.
